title: gibasis karwinskyana

This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, cough, and respiratory issues, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
